notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may be out of date, or the address slightly off. The paintings are all still here — start from the catalogue.

cookies.title: About cookies on this site
cookies.text: We keep only what the gallery cannot work without: your sign-in session and your cart. There is no analytics and there are no advertising trackers at the moment — if they are ever added, they will not run without your consent.

necessary.name: Necessary
necessary.text: The gall_refresh cookie keeps you signed in for up to 30 days and cannot be read by scripts on the page. Browser storage holds: gall_guest_token, so the cart and orders work without an account; gall_theme, the theme you chose; and support-widget-dock, where you dragged the support button. The site does not work without these, so they cannot be switched off.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.text: Anonymous visit statistics: which pages get read and where visitors arrive from. Not connected to the site yet. Your choice is remembered and takes effect if and when they are added.
